description: Synthetic: a finished auto-mode turn reports on two PRs and ends by handing the user a `! gh pr merge` command. Below it Claude Code prints its notes on background agents (one finished, one waiting on its own work), a live "Waiting for 2 background agents to finish" row, and an agents panel tall enough to push the mode line out of the last rows. The handed-over command is still an offer (one Send it, not a question's reply), so the pane waits on the user rather than on the agents.
